options.name: all_proxy
options.description: The URL of the proxy to use for all protocols. Proxy URL precedence (highest to lowest): C(https_proxy) -> C(http_proxy) -> C(all_proxy) module params, then C(HTTPS_PROXY) -> C(HTTP_PROXY) -> C(ALL_PROXY) env vars. C(all_proxy). If not set then the value of the C(ALL_PROXY) environment variable is used.

options.name: http_proxy
options.description: The URL of the HTTP proxy to use. Proxy URL precedence (highest to lowest): C(https_proxy) -> C(http_proxy) -> C(all_proxy) module params, then C(HTTPS_PROXY) -> C(HTTP_PROXY) -> C(ALL_PROXY) env vars. C(http_proxy). If not set then the value of the C(HTTP_PROXY) environment variable is used.

options.name: https_proxy
options.description: The URL of the HTTPS proxy to use. Proxy URL precedence (highest to lowest): C(https_proxy) -> C(http_proxy) -> C(all_proxy) module params, then C(HTTPS_PROXY) -> C(HTTP_PROXY) -> C(ALL_PROXY) env vars. C(https_proxy). If not set then the value of the C(HTTPS_PROXY) environment variable is used.

options.name: no_proxy
options.description: Comma-separated list of hosts or domains to bypass the proxy. Precedence (highest to lowest): C(no_proxy) module param -> C(NO_PROXY) environment variable. If not set then the value of the C(NO_PROXY) environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_api_key
options.description: Prism central API key. Created using Service Account API Key in Prism Central. C(nutanix_api_key). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_API_KEY), environment variable is used. This field is only supported for Prism Central.

options.name: nutanix_debug
options.description: Enable detailed debug logging for all API calls made by this module. When enabled, logs will include HTTP method, URL, headers, request body, response body, status code, and elapsed time. Authorization headers and sensitive information are automatically redacted. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_host
options.description: Prism central hostname or IP address C(nutanix_host). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_HOST), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_log_file
options.description: The file to write the logs to. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_password
options.description: Prism central password C(nutanix_password). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_PASSWORD), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_port
options.description: Prism central port C(nutanix_port). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_PORT), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_username
options.description: Prism central username C(nutanix_username). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_USERNAME), environment variable is used.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: The password for proxy authentication (if not embedded in proxy URL). Precedence (highest to lowest): URL-embedded credentials -> C(proxy_password) module param -> C(PROXY_PASSWORD) environment variable. If credentials are embedded in the proxy URL (e.g., C(http://user:pass@proxy:port)), they take precedence. If not set then the value of the C(PROXY_PASSWORD) environment variable is used.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: The username for proxy authentication (if not embedded in proxy URL). Precedence (highest to lowest): URL-embedded credentials -> C(proxy_username) module param -> C(PROXY_USERNAME) environment variable. If credentials are embedded in the proxy URL (e.g., C(http://user:pass@proxy:port)), they take precedence. If not set then the value of the C(PROXY_USERNAME) environment variable is used.

options.name: read_timeout
options.description: Read timeout in milliseconds for API calls.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the module. If state is present, the module will revert a VM from a recovery point. If state is not present, the module will fail.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Set value to C(False) to skip validation for self signed certificates This is not recommended for production setup C(validate_certs). If not set then the value of the C(VALIDATE_CERTS), environment variable is used.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the  CRUD operation to complete.
